ETH trading volume is right up against BTC—will the 2443 level of paper be pierced today?

The most interesting thing about the midday market isn’t up or down, it’s volume. ETH volume is $11.04 billion, BTC is $12.28 billion—Ethereum’s volume is almost pressed up against Bitcoin’s, like it’s staring it in the face. You don’t see this kind of scene a few times a year. Who’s doing the real work with real money? It’s crystal clear. 

BTC is at 76,510, up 0.88%; the intraday high is 76,749, just one step away from the daily sell point at 76,801. It’s ground through the whole morning without breaking through with volume—are the main players not full yet, or are they looking to shake things up one more round? The intraday low is 75,025. As long as it retraces without breaking the daily buy point at 75,286, the structure hasn’t broken. If it holds above 75,913, it’s still bulls’ territory.

ETH is even more ruthless: price is 2,441, and the daily sell point at 2,443 is right in front of it—just a $2 distance. The day’s low is 2,365, and it’s exactly just below the daily buy point at 2,378; it tapped there and bounced—someone was picking up at that spot, clearly and unmistakably. If 2,443 is pierced, there’s fresh upside space above.

Funding rate is the real key point today. BTC: 0.0049%; ETH: 0.0024%—the long side still hasn’t even paid the down payment. Prices are up, but leverage hasn’t gotten overheated. That means this move isn’t being driven by retail FOMO. 

The truly dangerous moment is always when funding gets hot—but today, it’s not. Look at XRP instead: down 0.06%, funding rate -0.0051%. While the whole market rebounds, it’s playing dead. Negative funding means shorts are still paying to keep things afloat—either they catch up with the rally, or they’ll be dragged along by the entire market. You choose.

BNB is up 1.36% and has reclaimed 725—steady like a ballast stone. Not much to say.

Conclusion: the data is generally bullish. A BTC break above 76,801 confirms acceleration; only if it breaks below 75,286 do we talk about risk again. ETH follows the same rhythm—2,443 is today’s deciding card. 

Caution should stay with the cautious, and data should stay with those who watch the data.
